summary: Iteration-3 testing: 55/55 backend pytest tests passing (30 regression + 13 iteration-2 updated + 12 new iteration-3). New coverage: Paystack live-test mode config (provider='paystack'), Paystack checkout initialization returning real https://checkout.paystack.com/ authorization_url with booking staying pending_payment, Paystack verify for incomplete transactions returning status='failed' (and NOT confirming the booking), Paystack webhook — 401 on invalid signature + 200 on valid HMAC-SHA512 signature using PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY which also confirms the booking (status=confirmed, payment_status=paid), owner payout-method endpoint (momo + bank happy paths + both 400 validation cases), morning-reminders cron (401 without secret, 200 {status:ok, morning_reminders_sent:N} with Bearer secret) + regression on /cron/send-reminders. Frontend Playwright: owner login -> Payouts tab -> payout-method-card renders, MoMo flow (pm-type-momo + pm-account-name + pm-momo-provider=MTN MoMo + pm-momo-number) saves via POST /owner/payout-method 200, toggle to Bank reveals pm-bank-name and pm-account-number fields; Checkout page /checkout/{bookingId} shows 'Card', 'Mobile Money', 'Secured by Paystack' labels and pay-btn with text 'Pay ₵ 180 with Paystack'. OPTIONAL live Paystack hosted-page card flow was NOT executed (marked skipped per the request — Paystack UI anti-automation + OTP step not reliably automatable).

minor.issue: Webhook handler does inline awaits for confirm_booking (sends email + updates DB) in the request path. Paystack retries webhooks on >5s delay; move to background task for safety.
When Paystack returns non-success, response is {status:'failed'} but no reason/code is surfaced to the client. Consider including result.data.gateway_response to help debugging.
Paystack init error path returns 400 with raw result.message — leaks third-party message to clients. Fine for test mode, consider mapping to a generic message in prod.
File now 1441 lines (up from 1386). Still well past the 700-line split threshold flagged in iteration-2. Not addressed.
Still using deprecated FastAPI on_event; migrate to lifespan handlers (flagged in iter-1 and iter-2).

issues: React console warning: 'A component is changing a controlled input to be uncontrolled' + 'value prop on select should not be null' when toggling between momo/bank. Caused by initial f.momo_provider / f.bank_name being null|undefined. Set defaults ('' or MOMO_PROVIDERS[0]) in the PayoutMethodCard useState initializer to avoid controlled→uncontrolled flip.

action_items: Fix controlled→uncontrolled React warnings in PayoutMethodCard (initialize momo_provider/bank_name/account_number/momo_number to '' instead of undefined).
(Carry-over) Modularize server.py (1441 LOC) into submodules — maintainability.
(Optional) Move paystack_webhook's confirm_booking into a BackgroundTask so the 200 ack is immediate.
critical_code_review_comments: paystack_webhook correctly uses hmac.compare_digest + SHA-512 (good). It looks up booking by both reference and payment_reference (good — matches checkout init which stores reference as the booking.reference).

verify_payment returns status='failed' without differentiating 'pending' vs 'failed' states from Paystack. For hosted-flow UX, consider surfacing 'pending' when data.status in ('ongoing','pending') so callback page can poll instead of showing a hard failure.

set_payout_method writes the payout_method to the user doc but doesn't mask/redact the account_number/momo_number in the audit log message (ok, number is not logged, but confirm). Consider validating momo_number is 10 digits + Ghana prefix.
PayoutMethodIn allows type='bank' with account_name only + extra momo fields present (no stripping of irrelevant fields on save). Low priority — just stored noise.
cron_morning_reminders filters by date==today (UTC). Accra is UTC+0 so this is correct for GH, but if the service is ever moved out of UTC, this will drift. Add explicit tz handling.
